expected_memories.content_gist: From 26 May 2020 any publication of a notification in respect of a notified body under Directives 90/385/EEC and 93/42/EEC becomes void
Certificates issued by notified bodies under Directives 90/385/EEC and 93/42/EEC before 25 May 2017 remain valid until the end of the period indicated on the certificate
Certificates issued under Annex 4 to Directive 90/385/EEC or Annex IV to Directive 93/42/EEC become void at the latest on 27 May 2022
Certificates issued by notified bodies from 25 May 2017 remain valid for no more than five years from issuance and become void at the latest on 27 May 2024

A device with a certificate valid under paragraph 2 may be placed on the market only if it continues to comply with the old Directives and there are no significant changes in design and intended purpose
expected_memories.condition: provided it continues to comply with Directive 90/385/EEC or 93/42/EEC and there are no significant changes in design and intended purpose

expected_memories.content_gist: The notified body that issued the certificate remains responsible for the appropriate surveillance of the devices it has certified
Devices lawfully placed on the market before 26 May 2020 may continue to be made available on the market or put into service until 27 May 2025
Devices that comply with this Regulation may be placed on the market before 26 May 2020 by way of derogation from the old Directives
Conformity assessment bodies complying with this Regulation may be designated and notified before 26 May 2020
Medical devices within the meaning of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 are added to the third paragraph of Article 2 of Regulation (EC) No 178/2002
The Commission may adopt measures determining whether a specific product or group of products falls within the definition of cosmetic product
